title: 1. Consolidated confirmation of the frozen construction ladder
hypothesis: Reward-trained residuals and incremental re-capture construction retain their accumulated success gain when every frozen controller faces identical cases.

prediction.rationale: Primary contrast: frozen R-121 JOINT minus D-072. A 30-point gain tests whether most of the previously measured 35-38-point improvement survives a common evaluation. Evaluate six hashed assets: D-058, D-072, R-106, R-116, R-118 CONTINUE and R-121 JOINT. This resolves the missing consolidated measurement without training or changing the saved default. Prospectively lock 24 manifests using historical paired discordance for the five-point sensitivity requirement. Six policies require 144 fresh processes, not 120. Predeclare a Holm family containing the primary contrast, five adjacent ladder contrasts and JOINT versus D-058. Report paired and manifest-clustered intervals, wins/losses/ties, R-120 failure labels and the complete result contract. Apply strict positive paired-interval qualification and one-sided 95% drop-difference upper bounds <= 0.05 against each declared promotion control; distinguish positive gains from gains exceeding the registered magnitude. Stop after this confirmation rather than extending it based on significance.

falsified_by: The upper 95% paired bound for JOINT minus D-072 is below +0.30; an interval spanning +0.30 is inconclusive about the registered magnitude, and an interval including zero establishes no positive difference.

result.notes: No deviation: six frozen, hash-verified controllers, each once per manifest in its own fresh process on 24 fresh 128-case manifests (seeds 5025, 5041-5063), 144 cells, 18,432 episodes, no training, no selection, no extension. One naming slip before the start, with no effect on any result: the implementer first wrote the manifests under a different file name than the approved record; the ledger refused to start, the files were regenerated under the recorded names (same seeds, same cases) and nothing had run. Sustained success of 3,072: D-058 saved incumbent 1,141 (0.371), D-072 reference 1,325 (0.431), R-106 residual 1,684 (0.548), R-116 re-capture module 1,978 (0.644), R-118 continued 2,372 (0.772), R-121 JOINT 2,446 (0.796). Every one of the seven contrasts is positive after Holm with a positive paired lower bound and a drop bound within 0.05: the primary JOINT minus D-072 +0.365 [+0.344, +0.386] (lower bound above the registered +0.30; 24 of 24 manifests), JOINT minus D-058 +0.425 [+0.404, +0.446]; steps: D-072 over D-058 +0.060, R-106 over D-072 +0.117, R-116 over R-106 +0.096 (300 wins, 6 losses), R-118 over R-116 +0.128, JOINT over R-118 +0.024 [+0.008, +0.040] (17 of 24 manifests; the smallest and least uniform step). Drops of 3,072: 140 / 140 / 96 / 127 / 136 / 136: the residual removed early drops (133 -> 89) and the re-capture adds about 40-47 late drops, so JOINT's drop count equals the incumbent's. Persistent-slow failures: 1,610 / 1,446 / 1,159 / 670 / 346 / 281; what grows with the re-capture is the fast-but-unsteady class (43 for D-058, 170 for JOINT). Earlier single-study estimates are reproduced within their intervals (R-106 +0.109/+0.125 -> +0.117; R-116 +0.082/+0.094 -> +0.096; R-118 +0.104 -> +0.128; JOINT over R-118 +0.059 in R-121 -> +0.024 here, i.e. the first estimate of the joint step was high). One evaluation on one set of 24 manifests of one task and simulator; the assets are frozen but not installed: config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent is unchanged.

verdicts.reasoning: On identical fresh cases (3,072 per policy) the frozen JOINT controller beats the D-072 reference by +0.365 paired sustained success, 95% interval [+0.344, +0.386], manifest-clustered [+0.348, +0.382], positive in 24 of 24 manifests; the lower bound is above the registered +0.30. The drop bound holds (difference -0.001, upper bound +0.004). Against the saved D-058 incumbent it is +0.425 [+0.404, +0.446] (2,446 vs 1,141), also with the drop bound. All five adjacent steps of the ladder are positive after Holm with positive lower bounds and drop bounds within 0.05; the smallest is JOINT over R-118 (+0.024 [+0.008, +0.040]).
verdicts.next_experiment: The direction's central question is answered: reward-trained symbolic construction on a competent reference, with an instrument sized to the effect, takes sustained success from 0.37 (saved incumbent) / 0.43 (reference) to 0.80. Report to the user: installing the R-121 JOINT finalist (or the simpler R-118 one, 0.772) as the incumbent asset is their decision. Within the loop: R-125's precondition can be checked for free on this archive (how many JOINT cases are slow through steps 30-60 and finish persistent slow); otherwise the remaining mechanism ideas are returning nulls and the direction is close to exhausted.

direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial rolling by testing reward-trained symbolic residuals and incremental policy construction. Use the frozen D-072-qualified controller as the experimental reference, without changing the saved default incumbent. First compare independent parameter draws, ARS/CEM and PPO on one identical sparse, state-conditioned symbolic residual family. If an inner learner produces a confirmed useful gain, compare fixed structure, grammar-based structural evolution and LLM-guided structural evolution with that learner and inherited parameters. Investigate compact memory or anchored component replacement only when the preceding results motivate them. Preserve the task, frozen evaluation manifests and strict paired promotion/drop criteria. Run one protocol at a time. No controller-generation LLM calls during P1; advisor calls for the research loop remain allowed. Later controller-generation calls need an agreed protocol and explicit call budget. Do not repeat R-102, retune its confirmation cases, reopen cold whole-controller generation, or resume expert cloning. Continue evidence-driven follow-ups within this direction through the existing loop, including its escalation and exhaustion rules.

implementer.reasoning: Approve. It is a pure evaluation of six already frozen and hashed assets on fresh cases, it is the measurement the direction is missing (every step was confirmed only against its own parent on its own manifests), and it is what an incumbent decision needs. Executable as recorded, with these implementation facts, all verified at run time and written to frozen_config.json before the first cell: D-058 = config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent (the saved default, read only); D-072 = the descriptor config/pen_spin/symbolic_reward_reference/reference.json; R-106 = config/pen_spin/r106_success_ars_finalist/finalist.json; R-116 = config/pen_spin/r116_recovery_finalist/finalist.json; R-118 = config/pen_spin/r118_continue_finalist/finalist.json (both in the original module ranges); R-121 = config/pen_spin/r121_joint_finalist/finalist.json (widened ranges). 24 manifests of 128 cases on seeds 5025 and 5041-5063, each policy once per manifest in its own fresh process (144 cells, 18,432 cases), one fixed order of policies per manifest. One seven-contrast Holm family on the two-sided case-paired t tests: JOINT minus D-072 (primary, threshold +0.30), the five adjacent steps (D-072 minus D-058, R-106 minus D-072, R-116 minus R-106, R-118 minus R-116, JOINT minus R-118) and JOINT minus D-058; manifest-clustered intervals, drop bounds, wins/losses/ties and R-120's labels for all six. No training, no selection, no extension. At the discordances seen between adjacent steps (0.07-0.22) 3,072 pairs give a paired SE of 0.005-0.009, so a five-point step is resolved with power above 0.99 even at the most conservative Holm step.
